description.value: The Courtenay & District Memorial Outdoor Pool is a municipally operated outdoor swimming facility in Courtenay on Vancouver Island, serving the broader Comox Valley community. As a public outdoor pool run by the City of Courtenay, it offers a seasonal aquatic destination for residents and visitors alike. Touring cyclists passing through the Comox Valley region may find it a worthwhile stop for a swim and a break from the road.

address.value: 489 Old Island Hwy, Courtenay, BC V9N 3P2, Canada
